oneOf.description:
Starting: only `handshake` and `daemon.status` are answered; any
other request is refused with `daemon_starting`.
Everything works, whatever tasks are running.

Going down, for a stop or a restart that is due: new runs are
refused, and connections close soon.
Startup failed, as `error` says; the daemon exits.

DaemonStatus.description:
The daemon's phase and what it is busy with: the `daemon.status` result,
the `daemon.status` notification, and [`crate::ServerHello::status`].

error.description: In phase `failed`: why, as a registry error.

tasks.description:
What the daemon is doing that a user would want to see, oldest
first. Free-form: clients show any task the same way.

DaemonTask.description: One thing the daemon is doing.

blocking.description: The daemon is not ready until this task ends.

detail.description: What it is on now, for people.

id.description: Stable for the task's life; opaque.

label.description: What it is, for people: "Moving sessions to the new storage layout".

GuestHello.description:
What a guest connection's handshake says about its link (client protocol
1.88.0): a client with this in its hello is a guest in one session.

total.description: Absent while the task does not know how much there is.

engine_version.description: The daemon's own version, for display and logs.

features.description:
What the daemon's configuration enables for clients. None are defined
yet; a client ignores one it does not know.

guest.description:
This connection came through a conversation share (client protocol
1.88.0): it reaches one session and what the link allows.

machine_id.description:
An opaque identity of the daemon's machine
(`paths::machine_id`), so a client can tell whether it runs on the
same machine; absent when the daemon cannot tell.

origin.description: The origin the daemon stamps on events this connection causes.

page_ticket.description:
What the web page stores in its `cookie_page_ticket` cookie to open
the daemon's plugin pages (client protocol 1.80.0): derived from the
daemon token, so rotating the token revokes it. Absent when the
daemon does not serve plugin pages on this connection's listener.

page_url.description:
Where the daemon's web page can be reached (client protocol 1.67.0):
its `[server] page_url`, when set. Clients build links into the
page from it, and otherwise from the URL they reached the daemon at.

protocol_version.description:
The daemon's [`crate::CLIENT_PROTOCOL_VERSION`]. The client sends a
method or member only if this version includes it.

share_url.description:
The base of the daemon's share links (client protocol 1.86.0,
`docs/site/specs/share-links.md` section 6.1): its `[share] url`,
else its `[server] page_url`, when either is set. Clients warn
before making a link when it looks private.

status.description:
The daemon's status when it answered (client protocol 1.65.0), sent
to clients of that version or later. A daemon that is still starting
answers with phase `starting` and keeps the connection; the
`daemon.status` notification says when it is ready. Absent from older
daemons, which answer only once ready.
